confidence_notes: Food and beer estimates draw on the June 2026 [Numbeo snapshot](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Boston). Cocktail and wine estimates use a [later local price guide](https://www.bostontourism.org/boston-nightlife/) and are roughly twice the domestic beer price. July accommodation prices are holistic estimates, with particular uncertainty around scarce private hostel rooms. Taxes and tips may add to the prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Boston is a high-cost northeastern US city, broadly comparable to New York, with strong summer tourism demand and limited budget accommodation.
